hints.title: Break-Point Tracking
hints.text: An alternating group is disrupted wherever two adjacent elements share the same color. Identifying these break points segments the ring into alternating intervals.

hints.title: Segment Contribution
hints.text: An alternating interval of length L contributes max(0, L - sz + 1) alternating groups of length sz.

hints.title: Dynamic Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain the lengths of contiguous alternating segments in a balanced ordered set and binary indexed tree to answer size queries and color modifications efficiently.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Fenwick tree and ordered set maintain dynamic alternating intervals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning array elements per query takes quadratic O(q * n * sz).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) tree and set memory provides logarithmic per-query latency.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models circular alternating blocks dynamically using Fenwick tree or segment tree.
